notes.page_content: Handwritten Version I: a topological-space/family statement with conditions (a),(b), two marginal notes, a two-member case, an oval cut by two chords, equations (1),(2),(2′), cancellations and a bottom closure argument.
notes.author_own_uncertainty: No independent explicit authorial question or uncertainty sentence was recovered on this sheet. Editorial candidate qualifications remain separate from the author’s readable wording.
notes.title_date_page_counts: Live heading Version I; no date or manuscript page count. Archive numeral 14 is recorded only in a comment; its hand is undetermined.
notes.actual_workflow: UTC clock read alongside the initial parallel text reads. Whole source viewed once for layout, half a once and half b once for full line reading, then 20 tight crops each created once and viewed once. The lower-half offset is 2360-1260=1100 pixels; all report bboxes use full-scan coordinates.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No mathematical computation or proof was performed. Bases, indices, bars, superscripts and inclusion directions were compared directly with ink; no expected implication selected a glyph.
notes.source_doubt_identity: Exactly 21 actual source rows, with separate decisions for row1 predecessor/Version, row9 parenthetical/relation, and row21 abbreviation/first index. Notation and slips-retained rows were not counted as source doubts.
crop_boundary_limitations: 12_equivaut.png clips the lowest q-tail endpoint; its complete descender was visible in half b.

15_symetriquement.png clips lower endpoints of the long y/q descenders; these were visible in half b. The small upper-right stroke in 17_lower_margin.png belongs to neighbouring main-line writing near the crop boundary and is not supplied a second time.
notes.graphics_maps: GUIDE01 origin (190,169); RULE01/02 origin (500,994); DRAW01 origin (19,1038), C brace paths translated locally by (5,33); CANCEL01/02 origin (206,1437); MARK02 cluster origin (409,2008); GUIDE02 origin (180,2158); GUIDE03 origin (1274,2097); CANCEL03 origin (920,2238). All are fixed local rectangles with positive source y drawn downward. Approximate Bézier bounds differ from observed target bboxes; the literal paths are in reading.tex.
notes.H_apparatus: H page14 identifies scan15. Its drawing description is apparatus; it was collated for the features it reports. H emphasis equals manuscript underlining only where the marked span agrees. Its ill placeholder in the lower marginal continuation is counted once (H26).
notes.validation: Completed one required source/report synchronization pass: balanced braces and environments, paired math delimiters, 21 source rows and 24 local decisions, existing crop paths, current candidate correspondence and graphical component references. No compiler or renderer used.
